scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Scheduled Caste Students
other_conditions: Scholarship is limited to a maximum of two successive years after matriculation
Renewal for the second year is subject to satisfactory performance in the first year of the course
The student must take admission to any professional/technical course after Matric in a recognized institution within or outside the state
Eligibility is based on being among the top 1250 meritorious SC students as per Matric Examination results
benefits_summary: Each eligible student receives ₹18,000 per year for up to two years.
